name: Late cart
summary: A late night group delivery order drawn as a scooter with a crate on the back: everyone taps dishes to drop them in as little boxes, a road meter fills toward the free delivery minimum and the headlight comes on when it's met. One person places it and each face shows what they owe.
useWhen: 12:48am 'i'm so hungry i could cry', who wants to order
group food delivery order, everyone add what you want
we need $25 for free delivery, who's adding something
splitting a late night takeout order between roommates
doordash run for the apartment, drop your order in
dontUseWhen: splitting a bill after you already paid (use settle-up or tab-claim)
